verses.1: For the leader; with stringed instruments. Of David.
verses.2: Hear my cry, O God, listen to my prayer!
verses.3: From the brink of Sheol I call; my heart grows faint. Raise me up, set me on a rock,
verses.4: for you are my refuge, a tower of strength against the foe.
verses.5: Then I will ever dwell in your tent, take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah
verses.6: O God, when you accept my vows and hear the plea of those who revere your name in prayer:
verses.7: "Add to the days of the king's life; may his years be many generations;
verses.8: May he reign before God forever; may your love and fidelity preserve him" -
verses.9: Then I will sing your name forever, fulfill my vows day after day.

notes.text: Brink of Sheol: literally, "edge of the earth," "earth" being taken in its occasional meaning "the underworld." Cf Jonah 2:3.
In prayer: added for sense. Psalm 61:7-8 express the plea of Psalm 61:6.
Then: Hebrew "just as," i.e., in accord with the vows referred to in Psalm 61:5.
